about.title: About Me
description: Working as a Senior Software Developer at Powertica Commodities AG.

Within a small team, I cover the complete IT agenda of the Risk department — from frontend and backend development to data pipelines (Airflow, Fabric, Databricks), database management, migrations, and architecture design. My work also includes reporting, testing, and creating technical documentation.

I actively integrate AI into company processes — from implementing MCP servers and fine-tuning models to automating workflows using modern tools. I also handle DevOps and deployment via GitLab and Docker.
My goal is to design robust and sustainable solutions that help businesses operate efficiently.
